--- Page 1 (Beckerman_92a) --- Dear Folks: Well, today is the day you've been waiting for. The radio has just blurted forth the newz that points have been reduced to where Abe and I both are eligible for discharge. Quite a break. They just lowered it to the point where it really counts. As a matter of fact I'm now in the process of trying to get another five points which I picked up in the course of my travelling over here. If I get it that will bring me over the required 75 mark. But under the new eligibility score it really dowsen't matter. As for Abe he will be tickled pink. All the boys that worked for me are getting out now, we're trying to replace them with civilians. Not trying to be pessimistic, I think it fair that you know that the shipping situation here in the Philippines is in a terrible mess and unless things start unravelling pretty soon it will be pretty hard for anyone to get home. I hope you're reading of the injustice many of the high point men over here are being subjected to. The Army had taken the easy way out by concentrating their discharges in the states with Europe a close second. The job of getting men out of the Pacific is the big headache and evidently has not yet been tackled. I think you ought to become conscious of the fact that the men in the Pacific are not getting their just break. Don't take this too seriously. Just blowing off a little steam. Will take that home with me. Other than that, things going along in fine high gear. Saw Chubby again who was down in Manila on pass. I wish you all the best of health--- and it won't be long now. Love Jack
